3955671.baseName: Habitat 6ft Snowy Half Design Christmas Tree
3955671.variantName: Habitat 6ft Snowy Half Design Christmas Tree
3955671.sourceDescription: Keep your baubles safe from curious paws and tiny hands with this clever half-design Christmas tree. Standing 6ft tall, it starts its branches at 93cm off the ground, putting your perfectly arranged decorations well out of reach of cats and toddlers. You're getting a full tree shape with hinged branches that unfold easily, finished with a light dusting of snow and 733 tips for that full, festive look. The fibreglass stand keeps everything steady, and it all packs away into its box when the season's over. The half design means you only need to decorate the upper portion, leaving you more time to enjoy the season and plenty of space underneath for presents. It's made from PVC with a mix of 3D and flat needles that you can fluff up to create that thick, realistic finish. Minimal assembly required, and the hinged branches make setup straightforward so you can go from box to festive centrepiece without fuss. . t53jmycd.sourceDescription: This beautiful artificial hinged Christmas tree is very lifelike in its shape and appearance and is meant to create just the right atmosphere for this Christmas.
